subject.title: fix(mattermost): add timeout to REST client requests

question: Should the Mattermost plugin land a 30s default REST request deadline for sends, reactions, uploads, lookups, directory reads, monitor probes, and target resolution?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but the default changes upgrade behavior for slow or stalled self-hosted Mattermost deployments from an unbounded wait to a timeout failure.

options.title: Accept the 30s default
options.body: Land after exact-head checks if maintainers prefer bounded Mattermost REST failures over indefinite hangs, with DM retry calls still able to use their configured deadline.

options.title: Tune the timeout policy first
options.body: Change the default or add an owner-approved narrow override before merge if slow Mattermost deployments need a longer supported REST deadline.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30s default
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head checks if maintainers prefer bounded Mattermost REST failures over indefinite hangs, with DM retry calls still able to use their configured deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent current-main history on the Mattermost client/send configuration boundary affected by this default.
